name: Avatar
description: User profile picture asset. 41 variants: 20 male personas (ava-man-1 to ava-man-20), 20 female personas (ava-woman-1 to ava-woman-20), and 1 placeholder (ava-placeholder-user). Each is a 128×128px frame with an illustration and a border overlay. Used in AppBar, Sidebar hover state, CandidateCard, ContentBlock(OptionMenus), and NotificationCard.

variant.description: Which avatar persona to show. Use ava-placeholder-user when no specific user is assigned.

size.description: Display size. The Figma asset is 128px; scale via CSS to the appropriate token size.

border.note: Overlay border ring — applied via CSS box-shadow or ::after

usage.notes: Always apply corner-radius.full to get the circular shape. Export as SVG or PNG from Figma for implementation. For user assignment, map user gender + assigned avatar number to the variant ID.

do: Always use ava-placeholder-user when no user is assigned.
Scale using CSS — don't change the Figma asset dimensions.
Apply corner-radius.full in code to make it circular.
dont: Don't use avatar illustrations outside of the defined persona set.
Don't stretch avatars out of their 1:1 aspect ratio.
